acceptance: A test lands a peer during the re-verify of a cycle, and the cycle still ships when its rebase is clean.
A rebase with a real conflict still goes back to audit.
A wave reports the number of re-audits that a ship race caused.
fix: Let a ship that loses the race rebase and re-verify the merged tree without a full re-audit when the rebase is clean and the change set is the same, or hold a short landing slot for a cycle after its audit.
summary: In wave 160, cycle 2211 hit GIT_FLEET_REBASE_NEEDED 5 times. Each loss sent it back to audit, and a peer landed during each re-audit. It sealed FAIL after 160.5 LLM minutes, 123.8 of them waste. The wave had 4 conflicts in 7 landings. GitHub issue #515 tracks the same race.
title: A cycle that loses the ship race re-audits, loses again, and fails after 5 tries
